notes: Seed $9M (EUR 7.6M / GBP 6.6M) led by Visionaries with firstminute capital, Sequel and Illusian plus angels incl. Hanno Renner and Andrey Khusid (tech.eu 2026-05-07; eu-startups; Tech Funding News headline 'Visionaries back CodeWords' $9M seed'). firstminute 'first backed the company at pre-Seed' (eu-startups, via Wayback); the pre-seed's date/amount are unpublished and Visionaries is not named in it, so the seed is the entry. The company started as Agemo, an AI research lab (eu-startups). Founded 2023 by Osman Ramadan and Aymeric Zhuo (Tech Funding News). Visionaries partner Robert Jäckle quoted. The list row had no website; www.codewords.ai is the product site (verified live). Only ~5 months since the seed, so no graduation expected.
